how: eval/run.py in the RuleMate repo: 38 questions (32 answerable, 6 not answerable from the texts), three designs with known verdicts, planted defects, and two real GA drawings with hand-counted truth.

items.note: the rest are shown as clause excerpts, not as an answer

items.metric: Citations that really support the sentence
Key numbers present in the answer
Questions outside the texts correctly answered 'not found'
Value exactly at the limit wrongly failed

groups.name: Reading drawings (optional Gemini)
groups.model: gemini flash (free tier), confirmed by local OCR

items.metric: NOAA GA: berth labels found by OCR
NOAA GA: room and berth count exact by Gemini
NOAA GA: Gemini readings confirmed on the sheet

groups.name: General answers (questions outside the rule texts)

items.metric: Not measured: general knowledge, not checked against any rule text

caveats: The questions and example designs were written by the team, and thresholds were tuned on them: expect lower numbers on new real data.
Only two real drawings were scored; drawings without printed room names give fewer readings.
General answers are not checked at all. Treat them as a starting point and confirm in the governing rules.
Every PASS / FAIL is computed in code from the clause text; a model never decides it.
